title: fix(app-shell): bind Studio create-dialog labels to their inputs (objectui#13128)
body:
Fixes #13128
Clause-②: no

## What changed

`CreateItemDialog`, the shared form behind every Studio create dialog, rendered its display-name and identifier labels with no `htmlFor`, and its two inputs had no `id`. A screen reader therefore heard two unlabeled edit fields, and `getByLabelText('Object name')` found nothing. Two `React.useId()` ids now bind each label to its input, unique per mount. There is no visual, copy, export or prop change.

The component is shared by five call sites in `StudioDesignSurface.tsx`, so all five dialogs get the binding: Create app, the Interfaces create dialog (report, page or dashboard), New object, New automation and New permission set. The seat ruled the file surface onto `CreateItemDialog.tsx` in comment 6285011413. The New object dialog's record-sharing picker is already named by the label element that wraps it, so it is unchanged.

## Pin

`CreateItemDialog.labels-13128.test.tsx` drives two real openers:
- New object, through the real `DataPillar` empty state;
- Create app, a sibling dialog, through the real `StudioDesignSurface` toolbar.

In each dialog, `getByLabelText` for the name label and for "Identifier" must find an `INPUT` with that accessible name. Label strings are read by catalog key.

## Ablation (one-shot, run at 1efc5df41a)

Run with objectstack's `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, which replaces the `Label htmlFor={labelInputId}` opening tag with a bare `Label` opening tag in `CreateItemDialog.tsx`, then reruns the pin:
- anchor x1 to x0; blob 8e7320e102f7 to a9b1abd818f1 (the mutation landed);
- `Tests 2 failed (2)`. Both legs go red because both dialogs share the component: "Found a label with the text of: Object name, however no form control was found associated to that label";
- restore: the blob after restore, 8e7320e102f7755e87fa8797cfb98bb39266d267, equals the HEAD blob of the file, and `git status` is clean.

## Verification (at af6b19e935)

- Closure build `pnpm --workspace-concurrency=2 --filter '@object-ui/app-shell^...' build`: exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell type-check`: exit 0. Its `tsconfig.test.json` includes `src/**/*.test.tsx`, so the new test is type-checked too.
- Targeted vitest, `--maxWorkers=1`, over the new pin plus every test file that renders `CreateItemDialog`: oneLabel-11787, storedName-11792, createAppAccessibleName, createObjectOwd, flowPresets-11861, newFlowTrigger-11788. Result: `Test Files 7 passed (7)`, `Tests 34 passed (34)`.
- The full `packages/app-shell/` directory is declared to CI. The order forbids whole-package runs on this shared box.
- Lint narrowed to the two changed `.tsx` files. Running `eslint --no-inline-config --format json` counted 2 files, 0 errors and 6 warnings. Five warnings are `no-explicit-any` in the test's mocks, the same shape its sibling suites use. One is the existing `react-hooks/set-state-in-effect`, which origin/main's copy of the file also reports. Both files resolve in the root `eslint.config.js`. The config sets no `parserOptions.project` or `projectService`, so type-aware linting is off and this diff cannot change the lint verdict on any untouched file.
- Battery: `check:phantom-deps`, `self-import`, `unreferenced-sources`, `doc-example-readers`, `handler-key-reads`, `side-effects-array`, `element-data-source-declaration`, `spec-symbols`, `action-forward-parity`, `designer-field-key-parity`, `icon-record-names`, `i18n-keys`, `i18n-drift`, `i18n-designer-parity` and `control-bytes` each exited 0. So did `check-hand-rolled-comment-mask.mjs`, `check-changeset-fixed.mjs` and `check-changeset-presence.mjs`.
- `check:spec-floors`: NOT MEASURED. It exited 1 with no-artifact because it needs a full workspace build, so its gate body never ran.

## Acceptance notes

- The changeset is `.changeset/13128-new-object-labels.md`, an `@object-ui/app-shell` patch that names the five dialogs.
